# ALTAIR by Sarkar

> ALTAIR is a nocturnal floral-woody parfum by Sarkar (sarkar.store), an Indian fragrance brand. 100 ML parfum concentration, priced at ₹1,199 (INR). Tagline: "For nights that smell like rain and feel like confidence."

## Key facts
- Brand: Sarkar
- Product: ALTAIR
- Concentration / size: Parfum, 100 ML
- Price: ₹1,199
- Fragrance family: Floral · Fruity · Woody
- Best worn: evenings and nights, monsoon / rainy weather, date nights, parties
- Notes: Cherry, Mulberry (opening); Night Jasmine, Datura (heart); Wood (base)

## Scent journey
- Arrival: cherry and mulberry — wet, glossy dark fruit
- Bloom: night jasmine and datura — white, narcotic night florals
- Linger: rain-darkened polished wood
